'''Slinte''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]] Slinte held the rank of an [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] and was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] as second-in-command to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Lanklyn]], ultimately answering to [[Darth Baras]]. When [[Empire's Wrath|Baras' apprentice]] arrived in search of a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Xerender]], Lanklyn got himself captured while tracking the Jedi and it was Slinte who had to greet and assist the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in his absence. Though Baras' apprentice was able to find and rescue Lanklyn, he later proved his incompetence and Darth Baras had force-chocked him over the [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], promoting Slinte to the now vacant post of the Commander. Slinte managed to hold onto the position and the apprentice had remembered his service. [[3641 BBY|Next year]] the apprentice was betrayed by Darth Baras, but was promoted to the rank of [[Emperor's Wrath]] by the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]]. The newly appointed Wrath returned to Hoth in search of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Greist]] and approached Commander Slinte, who was unaware of Sith politics and assumed Baras sent his apprentice to dispose of him. However, the Wrath demanded General Greist's location before killing him to keep him silent.<ref name="Reallocation" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Warrior could suggest to tell him to ignore Darth Baras' call, play dumb or kill him. If he tells him to ignore Darth Baras' call, he will disappear to avoid dying.<ref name="Reallocation">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Reallocation|Hoth}}</ref> If the player chose to lie to Slinte and tell him Baras' order to keep the location of Greist's men a secret excluded them, he will give the location and depart.<ref name="Reallocation" />
